cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(zenith_native)

# Transpiled Zenith C++17 source (generated by: zenith lib/main.zen -target cpp -o android/main.cpp)
set(ZENITH_SRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp)

# Android native library with JNI support for Dart/Flutter integration
add_library(zenith_native SHARED 
    ${ZENITH_SRC}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../android/app/src/main/java/com/zenith/app/ZenithActivity.java
)

target_include_directories(zenith_native PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../rust/include
)

target_compile_options(zenith_native PRIVATE -O3 -std=c++17)

# Link Android system libraries and Rust native library
target_link_libraries(zenith_native
    android
    log
    m
    EGL
    GLESv2
)

# Add Rust library if available
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../rust/target/aarch64-linux-android/release/libzenith_native.a)
    target_link_libraries(zenith_native
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../rust/target/aarch64-linux-android/release/libzenith_native.a
    )
endif()
